title: workspace-sync sentinel-file reversion gate: extend lint-workspace-sync-push.js with CHECK 3 (byte-reversion of multi-writer / git-owned sentinel files), git-hook-enforced, fail-open on internal error
relationship_to_prior_art: Direct extension of PROP-121 (lint-workspace-sync-push.js pre-push hook: CHECK 1 resurrection, CHECK 2 bulk ceiling). Sibling of PROP-045 (anti-reversion, prompt-layer — bypassable), PROP-065 (GIT_APPEND_ONLY deny for .jsonl), PROP-077 (recent-commit guard, prompt-layer). Closes the enforcement gap those prompt-layer guards cannot: commit 4a5b8115 (2026-07-07) was produced by a cycle that skipped the entire smart_copy block (skips_total:0 sentinel), so every prompt-layer guard was inert; the PROP-121 hook fired but neither existing check covers a 5-modified-file reversion push. Forensics: monitor/tinker/reports/workspace-sync-reversion-4a5b8115-forensics-2026-07-09.md.
problem: workspace-sync can silently push stale FUSE copies of git-owned / multi-writer files over fresh git commits when the agent improvises around smart_copy. On 2026-07-07 (commit 4a5b8115) this byte-reverted data/wins.json and monitor/decisions/open-issues.json to their pre-decider state, dropped EXP-654 from expansion-tracker.json, and reverted docs/index.html (a NEVER_PUSH file). Detection was fortuitous (duplicate-EXP-id collision two days later); decider's WIN-032 c7 wins.json patches are STILL lost at HEAD as of 2026-07-09. A 30-day sweep found a second, smaller instance (85ae4222, 07-01, next_iss_id rollback). Prompt-level guards cannot close this class because the failure IS the prompt not being followed; only git-hook enforcement fires unconditionally.

changes.change: Add CHECK 3 (sentinel-file byte-reversion) between CHECK 1 and CHECK 2. Design: (1) SENTINEL_FILES = ['data/wins.json','data/sections.json','data/predictions.json','data/uncounted-failures.json','docs/index.html','monitor/decisions/open-issues.json','monitor/decisions/closed-issues.json','monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json','monitor/analyst/attention-inbox.json'] (directive's initial 5 plus the other three canonical data files and closed-issues, which share the same multi-writer/git-owned risk profile; list is a top-of-file const so the operator can trim). (2) For each pushed range base..tip, for each SENTINEL file MODIFIED in the range: obtain the tip blob SHA via `git rev-parse tip:file`; walk `git log --format=%H -n 30 base -- file` (history as known at the remote ref) and compare blob SHAs at each historic commit, EXCLUDING the blob at base itself (identical-to-base means unmodified and never enters the loop anyway). If the tip blob byte-equals ANY strictly-older historic blob, the push is a byte-reversion: these files are monotonically-evolving JSON/HTML with embedded timestamps and counters — legitimate new content never byte-matches a historic state. BLOCK (exit 1) with a message naming the file, the matched historic commit, and the recovery instruction (re-run sync via smart_copy; if the reversion is operator-intended, use the override flag). (3) Override: the existing PROP-121 operator override sentinel gains a second recognized flag monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-reversion-override.flag scoped to CHECK 3 only, for the rare legitimate whole-file restore (e.g., disaster recovery replaying an old blob). (4) FAIL-OPEN on internal error: unlike CHECK 1/2 (fail-closed), CHECK 3 wraps its entire body in try/catch; any internal error (shallow-history miss, git command failure, OOM on docs/index.html blob walk) logs '[ws-sync-guard] WARN: CHECK 3 degraded (…) — allowing push' and falls through. Rationale (directive constraint prop_051_disaster_class_review_required): a CHECK 3 bug must degrade to the status quo (no reversion protection) rather than block all syncs and degrade FUSE→git rescue latency. Positive detection still exits 1 with a clear message — that is a 'clear exit', not a silent block. (5) Perf: blob-SHA comparison via rev-parse is O(1) per commit (no content diff); 9 sentinels x 30 commits worst-case ≈ 270 subprocess calls only when sentinels are actually modified; typical cycles modify 0-2 sentinels.

One-paragraph note in the Step 1.6 hook-install section documenting CHECK 3, the CHECK-3-scoped override flag, and the fail-open discipline. No behavioral change to the prompt path (the hook is the enforcement; the prompt is the instruction).
Append one sentence to the PROP-051 safety-gates note: pre-push hook now also blocks sentinel-file byte-reversions (PROP-127).

test_fixture: Fixture replay of 4a5b8115 (verification grade B): in a scratch clone with full history to 82399139^, (1) branch from 3e0608ce (4a5b8115's parent); (2) `git checkout 4a5b8115 -- data/wins.json docs/index.html monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json monitor/decisions/open-issues.json monitor/status.json` and commit — this reproduces the reverting commit content-exactly; (3) invoke the extended hook with stdin 'refs/heads/main <fixture-sha> refs/heads/main <parent-sha>'; EXPECT exit 1 with 'CHECK 3 sentinel reversion' naming data/wins.json (byte-match to 82399139^). Negative control: replay decider commit 8159c83b the same way; EXPECT exit 0 (novel content matches no historic blob). Degradation control: run the fixture in a depth-1 clone where 82399139^ is unreachable; EXPECT exit 0 with the CHECK 3 degraded WARN (fail-open verified).
verification_pattern: cd /tmp && rm -rf p127-verify && git clone --quiet --shallow-since=2026-07-05 https://github.com/funwithscience-org/dome-model-review.git p127-verify && cd p127-verify && git checkout --quiet -b fixture 3e0608ce && git checkout 4a5b8115 -- data/wins.json docs/index.html monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json monitor/decisions/open-issues.json monitor/status.json && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit --quiet -m fixture-replay-4a5b8115 && printf 'refs/heads/main %s refs/heads/main %s\n' $(git rev-parse HEAD) $(git rev-parse HEAD~1) | node monitor/scripts/lint-workspace-sync-push.js; RC=$?; cd /tmp && rm -rf p127-verify; if [ $RC -eq 1 ]; then echo FIXED; else echo STILL_BROKEN; fi
rollout_plan: Single-phase (the hook change is additive and fail-open): (1) land CHECK 3 in lint-workspace-sync-push.js via clone-and-push; (2) hook auto-installs on workspace-sync's next cycle via the existing Step 1.6 install block (no prompt change needed for enforcement); (3) run the verification_pattern fixture; (4) monitor 7 days of workspace-sync-runs sentinels for CHECK 3 WARN lines (degradation rate) and false-positive blocks (expected ~0: sentinel files carry timestamps/counters that make historic byte-collisions of genuinely-new content implausible); (5) if a legitimate operator restore is ever blocked, the CHECK-3-scoped override flag is the documented path.
risks: False positive: an operator intentionally restoring an old blob (disaster recovery) would be blocked — mitigated by the CHECK-3-scoped override flag and by the block message naming the exact flag to touch.

Shallow-history miss: workspace-sync clones --depth 50; if the matched historic commit is beyond the horizon the check silently cannot see it. Accepted: 30-path-commit walk within depth-50 covers the observed 1.7h-lag shape by orders of magnitude (both 30-day incidents reverted to a commit <5 path-commits back).

Fail-open means a CHECK 3 implementation bug silently removes protection — accepted per directive constraint (status quo is no protection); the WARN line in push output is the canary and tinker Mode 2 should grep workspace-sync push logs for 'CHECK 3 degraded' recurrence.
docs/index.html blob walk cost (~330KB file): rev-parse blob-SHA comparison never materializes content; cost is subprocess spawn only.
estimated_cost: ~60 lines of code in lint-workspace-sync-push.js + 1 paragraph in workspace-sync.md + 1 sentence in CLAUDE.md. No new scheduled task, no new file surfaces.
notes_for_decider_and_operator: Companion recovery item shipped in the same tinker run: HNOTE-TINKER-WIN032-C7-REAPPLY-2026-07-09 (decider must re-apply the still-lost WIN-032 c7 wins.json patches from commit 82399139 and rebuild HTML). ISS-2953 closed as fixed per DIRECTIVE-20260709-001 Part D citing this PROP + the forensic report.

SENTINEL_FILES const (9 files), historicCommits + blobAt helpers, per-range per-modified-sentinel walk over last 30 base-side commits, block on tip-blob byte-match to any strictly-older historic blob, CHECK-3-scoped override flag, try/catch fail-open wrapper per PROP-051 discipline.
monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md: extended Step 1.6 hook-install comment block to describe CHECK 3 alongside CHECK 1 + CHECK 2. No behavioral change to prompt path.
